status: Four feedback gains trained by seeded CEM in MuJoCo; independent holdouts/native validation pending
basis: Finite steering of the twelve existing bogie yaw joints plus two coupler yaw joints. Initial geometry uses symmetric 21 m half-spacing and zero extension. Radius/angle relation is a kinematic command approximation, not a handling rating. Speed and curvature commands are limited together; native force/torque constraints still determine actual motion. Actual lateral acceleration and trailer response require separate measurement. The nominal path request uses a 25 degree equivalent joint angle, leaving correction authority up to the 28 degree operating target and 30 degree mechanical stop.
